claims.statement: Method trial anchored-close: Should the method-trial repair enforce close chronology, decision-content anchoring and fail-closed inspection in the producer, instead of relying on the documented convention? Selected method: Enforce the contract structurally: require the exact decision commit, reject a close at that commit or at a non-descendant revision, recompute the trial digest, reject a second closing observation, fail closed when the explain envelope is truncated, and surface a lesson-informed result to method context through a direct relation. Expected observation: After the change, each named command behaves as specified: a close whose source_revision equals decision_commit exits non-zero; a second close of the same trial exits non-zero; show --limit 1 exits non-zero; show at the later result revision reports trial_digest_match MATCH and predecision_commitment_preserved true; the legacy unanchored trial reports trial_digest_match NOT_ASSESSED and preserved false; method context on the prior lesson lists the trial result.

attributes.question: Should the method-trial repair enforce close chronology, decision-content anchoring and fail-closed inspection in the producer, instead of relying on the documented convention?
attributes.method: Enforce the contract structurally: require the exact decision commit, reject a close at that commit or at a non-descendant revision, recompute the trial digest, reject a second closing observation, fail closed when the explain envelope is truncated, and surface a lesson-informed result to method context through a direct relation.
attributes.assumptions: The committed decision carries a trial_digest; the close episode can name the decision commit; git merge-base is available locally; explain reports truncation explicitly in its envelope.
attributes.expected_observation: After the change, each named command behaves as specified: a close whose source_revision equals decision_commit exits non-zero; a second close of the same trial exits non-zero; show --limit 1 exits non-zero; show at the later result revision reports trial_digest_match MATCH and predecision_commitment_preserved true; the legacy unanchored trial reports trial_digest_match NOT_ASSESSED and preserved false; method context on the prior lesson lists the trial result.
attributes.claim_ceiling: One same-agent implementation trial of an enforcement mechanism. It does not establish that the enforcement was needed, that the method caused a better outcome, or that another agent benefits.
